corrections.reason: The preposition prefix is 1st-order ከ ('ከርሱ ለማነጻጸር' = to compare with Him), misread as 6th-order ክ due to slight serif wear.
The 1st-person plural jussive prefix in Amharic is 6th-order እ ('እንሹማችሁ' = 'let us appoint you'), which is visible in the image and required by grammar.
In the physical column image, line 1 ends with 'እ' and 'ንዘ' wraps onto the beginning of line 2.
Line 2 begins with 'ንዘ' completing 'እንዘ' from the end of line 1.
Canonical Ge'ez plural verb 'ወፈርሁ' (and they were afraid, John 6:19, translated 'ፈሩ') paired with plural 'ወደንገፁ'; 2nd-order ሁ was misread as ኀ.
Canonical Ge'ez 2nd-person masculine plural prohibitive 'ወኢትፍርሁ' (John 6:20, translated 'አትፍሩ' in line 17); 2nd-order ሁ was misread as ኀ.
